The reason I bring it up is because I want to discuss the idea of not mirroring reddit to a t, but rather improve on the structure. Since it is still growing, I would imagine that theres still a chance to influence improvements. The ideas verse is great for new ideas, and the announcement is for major additions from the developers, but I haven't found a spot for the in between where users can give feedback on new changes. Today I am unable to check my previous posts but feel that if there was a verse discussing recent or upcoming changes it will allow adjustments easier. Aside from that, the new posting limit is too early to implement, especially in such a growing stage. By posting to 3 different verses, and halted on the fourth felt very limited. Especially since the site is not being overwhelmed with users, and a majority of the more active users came from /r/conspiracy for a more open alternative media & current events (which I think is a great anchor point to focus on but thats for another discussion). Now I understand the need to prevent over-posting, but when going through my accumulated rss feed, I rather be able to share what articles I feel are worth posting than to just choose 3. Especially with world events & news. I can understand how someone can abuse the freedom, but I personally am not for collecting upvotes, but rather sharing content. It seems somewhat like a catch 22, and the Ideas verse seems to be the best place to post this for the time being, but I do feel that there should be some sort of more flexible solution. I mean, I am not peeved but felt it was worth noting. I can admit that I do post a fair amount of content but wanted to address the issue circumstantially instead of abiding by the previous reddit system.

Upon expanding on the structure of reddit, I do have some great ideas that would turn it into more than what reddit was, but I want to be able to present a full concept design before discussing it due to complexity (which I intend to do at a future date). Though I'll mention implementing some sort of a unified feed processing that can allow a created verse to act as custom feed lists. Thus user content would be added to it and have the option for a user to organize it by date, but then can be ordered based on recent voting (popularity), and all sorts of other fine tuned searches. It is essentially a reflection on the current set up, but instead builds a platform for someone to implement add ons such as importing external RSS feeds or social feeds for a user to create their own custom 'verses' of content. This will also require some sort of behind the scenes to allow a verse to fit anywhere on the spectrum of private to public based on the verse's settings. After all it was the idea of bringing content sharing and community together that helped reddit succeed in being what it was. With the lack of google reader, I think that it could create something better than reddit, yet still carry on everything the community like it for. I think of it as the concept of why it was the way it was, it was the idea of creation that made it new. If one was to just replicate another creation, then where is the innovation? It would be a change and goes against replicating Reddit, but what if just found a better way to do what reddit did, plus also be more by inspiring user created feeds.

Also, typing all this, I feel that there should be a more adaptive typing space (maybe with post preview) for starting discussion posts.

But the focal point I think is to allow a verse that is approved by the developers fitted for current user feedback & minor updates regarding the sites growth.
Since Whoaverse is still growing, can there be a designated Verse for discussing current issues regarding the site? (and some other things regarding recreating reddit vs innovative creation)
